headline: Africa Finance Corp and Munich Re Deploy $1 Billion Risk-Sharing Scheme
summary: The Africa Finance Corporation and Munich Re launched a $1 billion risk-sharing programme designed to expand bank lending across Africa.
why: Risk-sharing agreements between multilateral financial institutions and major global reinsurers provide credit enhancement that unlocks commercial capital for infrastructure and trade finance in developing markets.

impacts.name: African Banking
impacts.why: Reinsurance backing reduces credit risk, enabling commercial banks to expand loan portfolios.
